body:
30959dcc47965713d8a78641e54c96d3831b29a1 try to handle padded image data.

Please let me know if it fixes skewed image for some formats.

> [30959dc](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/30959dcc47965713d8a78641e54c96d3831b29a1) try to handle padded image data.
> 
> Please let me know if it fixes skewed image for some formats.

Works great now 🙂 I can get all formats to display.

However, in https://github.com/shiena/godot-camerafeed-demo, switching formats occasionally leads to a black screen until I resize the window (the webcam display appears as a tiny square in the top-right corner). Sometimes, switching formats will still result in a black screen until I restart the project. No errors or warnings are printed in the output log. This is presumably a bug in the demo rather than in this PR though.

cc @shiena

I didn't take into account that camera feed format could change while activated (current implementation just remember selected format index to use before next feed activation), maybe there are still parts that can be improved.

> I didn't take into account that camera feed format could change while activated (current implementation just remember selected format index to use before next feed activation), maybe there are still parts that can be improved.

With 76a317e01393822c7c0c3adcdb875508589618f8 and https://github.com/shiena/godot-camerafeed-demo/commit/a10d76c74b03367cfdc10e60d9d7d6a35d14443a, camera feeds should be able to change format while still active.

The problem of disappeared camera preview after stopping and starting the feed without changing format seems to be caused by rotation of camera preview in [godot-camerafeed-demo](https://github.com/shiena/godot-camerafeed-demo/blob/8f0a94ff6e088c2e547b13e21c26d39620e4b57d/scripts/Main.gd#L196).

The last issue that I'm aware of is that, after changing feed format, it does not take effect immediately. On my machine with a USB webcam, camera feed still output a frame or two in previously configured format, even when camera feed is deactivated then activated again.

What's changed in bd58ba294a8748e79282aa2edf4ba95faaaa06a2:

- Feed formats now provide multiple frame rates for the same resolution if available.
- Feeds now support both `FEED_YCBCR` (yuvs) and `FEED_YCBCR_SEP` (420v, 420f) datatypes, `FEED_RGB` (RGB, RGBA) should also be supported.

If you run into errors by switching feed formats to the same frame size but different pixel format (e.g. 160x120 420v to 160x120 yuvs), that's because [camera feeds create new texture only when frame size are different](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/5d9722e83288f33827bcad70561f0737f8cde456/servers/camera/camera_feed.cpp#L232). I plan to submit another PR to fix that.

EDIT: f4ba7d4b002d463fa1464901c098033316871dad added fourcc -> format name helper for `CameraFeedMacOS` as suggested by @shiena. Only `kCVPixelFormatType_24RGB` is handled at the moment, since the value doesn't follow the four character code convention like `kCVPixelFormatType_32RGBA` or `kCVPixelFormatType_420YpCbCr8BiPlanarVideoRange`.
eb7fd5ba8f5b94eb328bb8a41f80721b0a543852 added format filtering to only include available formats currently supported by `CameraFeedMacOS` driver.
